quiz.title: Apache Kafka
quiz.description: Event streaming with Apache Kafka: topics, partitions, producers, consumers, and brokers.

questions.question_text: What is Apache Kafka primarily used for?
questions.option_a: Publishing, storing, and subscribing to streams of events in real time
questions.correct_answer: Publishing, storing, and subscribing to streams of events in real time

questions.option_a: A named stream of records that producers write to and consumers read from
questions.correct_answer: A named stream of records that producers write to and consumers read from

questions.option_a: Publishes (writes) records to a Kafka topic
questions.correct_answer: Publishes (writes) records to a Kafka topic

questions.option_a: Reads and processes records from a Kafka topic
questions.correct_answer: Reads and processes records from a Kafka topic

questions.question_text: What is a Kafka 'partition' used for?
questions.option_a: Splitting a topic's data across multiple logs to allow parallelism and scalability
questions.option_b: Encrypting all messages in a topic
questions.correct_answer: Splitting a topic's data across multiple logs to allow parallelism and scalability

questions.option_a: A server that stores data and serves client requests as part of a Kafka cluster
questions.correct_answer: A server that stores data and serves client requests as part of a Kafka cluster

questions.question_text: What is a 'consumer group' in Kafka used for?
questions.option_a: Allowing multiple consumers to share the work of reading from a topic's partitions
questions.correct_answer: Allowing multiple consumers to share the work of reading from a topic's partitions

questions.question_text: Why is Kafka often used as a central hub between many data producers and consumers?
questions.option_a: It decouples producers and consumers, letting them operate independently and at different speeds
questions.option_b: It requires producers and consumers to run on the same machine
questions.option_c: It only supports one consumer at a time
questions.option_d: It cannot handle more than 10 messages
questions.correct_answer: It decouples producers and consumers, letting them operate independently and at different speeds

questions.question_text: What does 'retention period' control in Kafka?
questions.option_a: How long messages are kept in a topic before being eligible for deletion
questions.option_b: How fast a consumer can read messages
questions.option_c: The number of brokers in a cluster
questions.option_d: The programming language used by producers
questions.correct_answer: How long messages are kept in a topic before being eligible for deletion

questions.question_text: Which of these is a common use case for Kafka in a data engineering pipeline?
questions.option_a: Streaming real-time events (e.g., clickstreams or sensor data) into downstream processing systems
questions.option_b: Storing a company's static HTML pages
questions.option_c: Managing user login sessions in a web app
questions.correct_answer: Streaming real-time events (e.g., clickstreams or sensor data) into downstream processing systems
